title: Drug efficacy systematic review
goal: A reviewer can trace 1,450 records through PRISMA 2020 screening to 42 included studies.

rubric.must: The PRISMA flow visibly shows identification, screening, eligibility, and included rows.
The 1,450 identified, 310 duplicates removed, and 1,140 screened counts visibly reconcile.
Visible exclusion side boxes account for 900 screened and 198 full-text exclusions.
The final box visibly reports 42 studies and 46 reports.
Directional connectors clearly trace the review flow.

ideal.notes: Independently authored using visual-eval/exemplars/prisma/single/ideal.svg (b70f305aa4ed); rendered and visually reviewed. Source retained faithfully but provisional: 240 assessed reports minus 198 excluded leaves 42, while source declares 46 included reports and 42 studies. Retrieval counts are unspecified, labelled as such rather than invented. Resolve source counts before using as a reviewed target.
